title: A Public Debate
grammar: Fixed phrases for agreements and parliamentary procedure
goal: I can say that parties reach an agreement or make a concession, with megállapodásra jut and engedményt tesz.
I can say that a proposal is put on the agenda or a resolution is passed, with napirendre tűz and határozatot hoz.
I can talk about a debate with four new words, such as közvita and kompromisszum.
I can say what a compromise is.
